summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, announcing the closing of its acquisition of LightSolver Ltd. and the appointment of LightSolver's CEO Dr. Ruti Ben Shlomi to its Board. The filing notes completion occurred on September 3, 2026, but provides no financial terms, consideration structure, or deal valuation. This strategic acquisition expands CollPlant from regenerative medicine into photonic computing, integrating LightSolver's Laser Processing Unit technology. Board appointment is a consequence of the closing. What to watch: future disclosures on deal financials and the integration/commercialization progress of LightSolver's photonic computing platform.
